lines.zh: 我在绯红森林里慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly through the crimson forest.

lines.zh: 我头顶的菌盖扫过低枝。
lines.en: My cap sweeps the low branches.

lines.zh: 红色的菌丝在我脚下蔓延。
lines.en: Red mycelium spreads under my steps.
Each step rumbles through the ground.
I go around a patch of glowing fungus.
Spores drift off me.

lines.zh: 我短短的双腿走得很稳。
lines.en: My short legs carry me steadily.
I walk into the middle of the fungal mat.
My crown glows in the dark.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看那些小蘑菇。
lines.en: I stop to look at the smaller mushrooms.
I sit like a great mushroom.
My cap swells and settles.
Spores float around me.
This whole mat belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的小东西。
lines.en: I listen to the small things in the wood.
There is dew on my crown.
I am in no hurry; I am old.

lines.zh: 我的根须在土里慢慢走。
lines.en: My roots travel slowly through the soil.

lines.zh: 一只小猪跑过，我看了看。
lines.en: A hoglin runs past and I watch it.

lines.zh: 我把身子往前倾了一点。
lines.en: I lean forward a little.
It is all dark under my cap.

lines.zh: 我在数落在我肩上的孢子。
lines.en: I count the spores settling on me.
I open my hands slowly.
This wood smells sweet.
My breath makes the mycelium sway.
I do nothing; I simply grow.
You have walked into my wood.
I raise my head and my cap dips.
You are much smaller than the hoglins.

lines.zh: 我头上的冠，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Do you see the crown on my head?

lines.zh: 这片菌毯是我一手养大的。
lines.en: I raised this mat myself.
There's fire on you. I can smell it.
Want to pick me? You cannot.

lines.zh: 我在这个林子里待得太久。
lines.en: I have been in this wood too long.

lines.zh: 你的斧子砍不动我的菌柄。
lines.en: Your axe will not bite my stalk.
I raise a hand and spores drift to you.
You cut into my cap.
A piece of my flesh is shaved off.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，菌盖仍压着你。
lines.en: I step back, my cap still over you.
Spores jet from my wound.
It hurts, and I do not fall easily.
This is a very old body.
You struck hard enough.
My mycelium trembles underfoot.
That made me bend.
The wood will remember for me.
Is that soil in your hand?
Set it down; I want to see.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我长一寸。
lines.en: That is not enough to grow me an inch.
My mycelium reaches over first.

lines.zh: 我的菌丝会自己过来取。
lines.en: My mycelium will come and take it.
It smells of rot; just right.
Don't back away; I am not in a hurry.
I will accept this little nourishment.
Just put it on the mat.
I tuck it under my cap.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，全是孢子。
lines.en: You hit me and spores go everywhere.

lines.zh: 我是这林子里最沉的东西。
lines.en: I am the heaviest thing in this wood.
You hit my cap and fell back.
The mycelium sticks to your boots.
I did not move at all.
We collide and a layer of spores falls.
You are covered in red specks now.

lines.zh: 菌盖一转，孢子撒了你一身。
lines.en: One turn of my cap dusts you with spores.
Don't come too close; my cap is poisonous.
Fungi do not work that way.

lines.zh: 整片林子都是我的后代。
lines.en: This whole wood is my offspring.

lines.zh: 你不该问一个蘑菇这个。
lines.en: You should not ask a mushroom that.
I shake my cap and spores scatter.
There are already enough spores.
I turn my head toward the mat.
I will see to that myself.
Get off the mat.
Do not touch my crown.
I reach out a short hand.
I press it into the mycelium.
It slowly dissolves in my palm.

lines.zh: 我举起来，让孢子盖住它。
lines.en: I hold it up and let spores cover it.
This thing is too dry.
I bury it under my feet.
It sinks into my cap.
I look at it; it is of no use.
I push it to the edge of the mat.
Leave it; something will grow.
You have stepped into the middle of the mat.
The eyes under my cap fix on you.
The king of this wood is me.
I begin to shift this way.
My spores drift toward you.
You are standing on my mycelium.
I raise a hand and the wood goes quiet.
You should not have come alone.
I spread my arms slowly.
The mycelium has reached your feet.
The mycelium moves first; I follow.
Every path here belongs to me.
No one treads on this throne.
I lift a foot slowly.
Come; my wood is waiting.
My mycelium spreads an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 你跑过菌毯，孢子跟着你。
lines.en: You run across the mat; spores follow.
My mycelium spreads ahead of you.
You turn among the crimson trees.
My crown glows red in the dark.
You are breathing in spores.

lines.zh: 这一整片林子都是我的眼。
lines.en: The whole wood is my eye.
The stalks you break make a sound.

lines.zh: 我抬手，前面的菌盖开了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and a cap ahead opens.
You ran a circle and came back.
I need not chase quickly.
You are nearly before me.
I stop and wait for you.
The shadow of my cap falls.
A few more steps and the path ends.

lines.zh: 我的孢子在你肺里发芽了。
lines.en: My spores are sprouting in your lungs.
Now there is only one step left.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，孢子四散。
lines.en: I bring my hand down and spores burst.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整个身子的重量。
lines.en: That carried the weight of my whole body.
The blow sends you into a tree.
My mycelium binds your feet.
You cut my arm; the wound is shallow.
I push you down onto the mat.
Spores plaster your eyes.
You are coughing badly.
I raise my hand for another.
You pull back; I follow slowly.
I hold you where you are.
Dark under the cap, isn't it.

lines.zh: 这一下你该站不起来了。
lines.en: That should keep you down.
I stoop and look at you.
I grow up out of the middle of the mat.

lines.zh: 菌盖先撑开，然后我才站起。
lines.en: The cap opens first; then I rise.
Red light falls on me.
This wood has waited for me a long time.

lines.zh: 孢子先飘出去，然后是我。
lines.en: The spores go out first; then I do.
When I stand, the trees seem shorter.
I spread my mycelium under my feet.
I open both hands slowly.
The smell of the wood has changed.
This stretch is mine to rule.
I lift my head, soil still on my crown.

lines.zh: 有脚步声进了我的林子。
lines.en: Footsteps have entered my wood.

lines.zh: 我低下身子，看着来的人。
lines.en: I lower myself to see who has come.
My cap is wider than a door.

lines.zh: 这一带的小东西都躲开了。
lines.en: The small things here have all hidden.
Good; the throne is ready.
I sit, and the ground moves.
The spores are beginning to sprout.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在菌盖下。
lines.en: I see you, there under my cap.

lines.zh: 火碰上我的菌盖，卷起一片。
lines.en: Fire meets my cap and curls it.

lines.zh: 我从高处翻下来，菌盖翻了。
lines.en: I tumble from a height and my cap flips.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的菌肉，沉得厉害。
lines.en: Water soaks my flesh and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 炸开我的半边身子，孢子乱飞。
lines.en: Half of me bursts open and spores fly.
An arrow sinks into my stalk.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我的菌丝里走。
lines.en: That force travels through my mycelium.

lines.zh: 没有腐土，我慢慢干下去。
lines.en: No rotting soil, and I dry out.

lines.zh: 雷劈开我的冠，焦了一圈。
lines.en: Lightning splits my crown and chars it.

lines.zh: 我整株往下掉，菌丝全断了。
lines.en: I fall whole, my mycelium tearing away.
